name: Daily Standup
description: Generate a daily standup update from git activity, Jira board, and open PRs.

nodes.name: Read recent activity
nodes.description: Read git log from the last day and list open PRs. Understand what was done and what is in flight.

nodes.name: Read Jira board
nodes.description: Read Jira tickets assigned to the current user that are in progress, in review, or done in the last day.

nodes.name: Compose standup update
nodes.description: Write a standup update with three sections: Yesterday (done), Today (planned), Blockers. Keep it to 3-5 bullets per section. Be specific — reference story IDs and PR titles. If no blockers, say None.
